title: 1949 Cuba trip with a small group
summary: After closing the band, Herman took a small group (Manne, Burns, Red Mitchell, Candoli, Milt Jackson and Dave Barbour) to Cuba for a month, booked by Gastel.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, what I did, rather than just have a dead cutoff, I put a closing time on the band which I think was December or something, and went home for Christmas, and then immediately after put together a small group and went to Cuba for a month. And the small group included Shelly Manne, Ralph Burns on piano, Red Mitchell on bass, Conte Candoli, Milt Jackson, and that's it -- oh, yeah, and Dave Barber.
Yeah. After I put the group together, he called and said he'd like to go to Cuba. So I said, 'Well, sure, come on.'
And when did you get -- was Carlos still involved?
Yeah, and he booked that trip.
A month we were there. We stayed in the -- it was a location for a month.
